note: Differences between the production recording and strict fireemu that are known and not aligned. Each entry names its rows and fields; a difference outside an entry is a MISMATCH. Header-level exclusions (strict-transport-security, x-robots-tag and the SDK-row headers) are in rows.mjs.

entries.reason: Production answers a request that accepts Brotli with a Brotli body (Content-Encoding: br, an ETag ending in -br); strict has no Brotli encoder. A request that accepts only br is answered as identity, one that also accepts gzip is answered as gzip (production answered br to `br;q=0, gzip` as well; that row is a cache hit). The decoded body of every row is the file the corpus deployed and is compared with the plain or decoded body of the strict answer; the ETag is compared by form once the -br suffix is removed (etagSuffix). Status, content type and the other headers of these rows are compared. The gzip rows (gz-gzip, gz-head-gzip, gz-json-gzip) are not differences: strict answers the same encoding, ETag and length.
entries.authority: coordinator ruling 15 (2026-11-11), narrowed to Brotli by ruling 26 and owner ledger 2458 (flate2 approved)

entries.reason: Production answers an unmatched path with its own 21,376-byte Page Not Found page. Its bytes are not shipped (owner decision, 2026-11-11), so strict answers with a short page written for fireemu (same status, content type, Cache-Control and Vary). Status, content type and the other headers of these rows are compared; the body size is not.
entries.authority: owner decision of 2026-11-11 (owner-decisions.md, relayed by the coordinator): no Google page bytes in the repository; earlier coordinator ruling 16

entries.reason: Production answers a request for a parent directory (/../outside.txt, /%2e%2e/outside.txt) with a 302 whose Location is an absolute URL on an internal origin host (content-prodNN-firebasehosting-origin.googleapis.com) that differs from one request to the next. Strict answers the same 302 (status, Cache-Control: private, Content-Type text/html; charset=UTF-8, an empty body, Accept-Ranges) with the same path after the host the request came to. Only the host is not compared: the Location is compared with the host replaced by the origin placeholder.
entries.authority: coordinator rulings 17 and 21 (2026-11-11), narrowed to the host by the follow-up recordings

entries.reason: The /__/firebase/<version>/*.js files are served by Google's CDN; a local fireemu has no network source for them and answers 503 offline.
entries.wildcardReason: Coordinator ruling 17 names the SDK files as a whole: Google's CDN serves them and a local fireemu answers 503 offline, so no field of these two rows can match.

entries.reason: Production's init.json holds the seven keys of the project's web app configuration; a local fireemu knows only the project id and a placeholder key, so the layout of init.json (its key set beyond apiKey and projectId) and the length of init.json and init.js differ. The production-vs-local comparison does not compare the body of init.js at all (only the run-vs-run comparison does). Status and the other headers of these rows are compared.

The hosted /__/auth/handler page is served by Firebase, not from the site's files; the recorded requests are HEAD and show its length (462 bytes). Its bytes are not shipped (owner decision, 2026-11-11), so strict answers with a stand-in page written for fireemu, of another length. Status and the other headers are compared.
entries.authority: owner decision of 2026-11-11 (owner-decisions.md, relayed by the coordinator): no Google page bytes in the repository; earlier coordinator ruling 20
